# 🚀 MF HyperFPS – Extreme FPS Boost (Fabric Optimized)

**MF HyperFPS** is the ultimate **Fabric optimization modpack** designed to push your Minecraft FPS to insane levels! Turn laggy 30 FPS into **300+ FPS** with smooth, fast, and buttery gameplay. Perfect for low-end and mid-range PCs, this pack makes Minecraft feel faster, more responsive, and completely stable while keeping the vanilla experience intact.

---

## ⚡ Features

* 🚀 **Massive FPS Boost** – Play smoother than ever
* ⚡ **Faster Chunk Loading** – Say goodbye to stutters
* 🧠 **Optimized Memory Usage** – Light on RAM, heavy on performance
* 🎮 **Smooth & Stable Gameplay** – Perfect for survival, PvP, or recording
* 🧩 **Vanilla-Friendly** – All improvements keep Minecraft familiar
* 💻 **Perfect for Low-End PCs** – Play like a pro even on weaker hardware

---

## 🎯 Who Should Download

* PvP players needing maximum FPS
* Content creators recording smooth gameplay
* Players with low-end or mid-range PCs
* Anyone wanting instant performance improvement
